children: The company said the asset was let on a 20‑year lease, featuring five‑yearly index‑linked rent reviews to provide long‑term inflation‑linked income.
Tritax added that the scheme delivers a yield on cost at the top end of its 6–8% guidance, ahead of initial expectations, and secures £9.8m of annual rental income.
Reporting by Frank Prenesti for Sharecast.com
